summary: All-in bruiser with a fast run-in stun, heavy sustain from W, and a level 5 tower-disabling dive. He wins brawls early; ranged champions that kite him and anyone who denies his W heal can beat him.
threats: Q (Thundering Smash) gives speed toward you; his next auto stuns.
W (Frenzied Maul) marks you; the second W on a marked target heals him for missing HP.
E (Sky Splitter) is a delayed bolt that slows; if he's inside it, he gets a shield.
R (Stormbringer) at 5: leaps in and disables towers, so dives become lethal.

matchups.why: Vayne out-ranges and out-kites him, and W (Silver Bolts) true damage shreds his bulk. E (Condemn) knocks him back during his Q run-in.
trading: Auto him whenever he walks up; he can't reach you without Q.
When he Qs at you, Tumble (Q) away or Condemn him back.
Stand next to a wall so Condemn can stun him.
Step out of the Sky Splitter circle before it lands.
matchups.early: Kite and farm. You have the range advantage; don't let him walk you down.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R dive is lethal near towers. Play away from tower when you're low.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and kite; don't let the wave crash into your tower if you're low.
matchups.jungle: He has no escape besides Q speed. Gank when it's down.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo. Crit and on-hit; armor boots if behind.
matchups.remember: Kite the Q, Condemn the run-in.

matchups.why: Kennen out-ranges Volibear and E (Lightning Rush) is fast enough to run from his Q speed boost. Volibear has to walk through poke to trade, and Kennen's stun cuts his all-in short.
trading: Auto + Q (Thundering Shuriken) when he steps up to farm; each hit builds your stun marks.
The moment he activates Q, E away. Don't let the empowered auto reach you.
With two marks on him, Q or W (Electrical Surge) for the stun when he commits, then walk back.
Never stand inside his Sky Splitter circle; walk out before it lands.
matchups.early: Win the poke war at levels 1–3. He can't heal through poke without landing W twice.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R can dive you under tower. Keep E up when the wave is near your tower, and use your R to stun him off.
matchups.wave: Hold the wave on your side so he has to run through poke to reach you.
matchups.jungle: Once he's used Q, he's slow and gankable. Ping your jungler then.
matchups.build: Electrocute. AP items; boots early for spacing.
matchups.remember: Rush away from the Q, stun on the way back.

matchups.why: Riposte parries Volibear's Q stun and stuns him back, and vitals' true damage cuts through his HP. But if he lands both W bites, his heal out-sustains her in long fights.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for his Q stun. That's the trade-winner.
After the parry, Lunge onto vitals and get out before his second W bite.
Step out of the Sky Splitter circle; fighting inside it gives him a shield.
If he lands Q while your W is down, disengage and wait for it.
matchups.early: Even. Trade only when your W is up and his Q is down.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R heal zone counters his W sustain, but his R tower dive threatens you. Fight away from your tower when low.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and fight in cooldown windows.
matchups.jungle: He's slow without Q. Gank once he's used it.
matchups.remember: Parry the Q stun, then punish before he bites twice.

matchups.why: Volibear wins every early brawl: Q stun into W heal out-trades Nasus before his stacks matter. Nasus can only farm safely and outscale.
trading: W (Wither) him as he Qs at you to slow his run-in.
Stack Q only when his Q is down.
E (Spirit Fire) to reduce his armor before you trade back.
matchups.early: Give up some creeps and farm under tower.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R tower dive is lethal. Stay healthy near tower; your R gives HP to survive.
matchups.wave: Farm under tower; stack Q on cannon minions.
matchups.jungle: Ask for an early gank when he overextends.
